title: Services: The New Software
source_type: venture capital thesis and market analysis
limitations: Venture capital investment essay framing the expansion from SaaS software budgets to services/labor budgets. Synthesizes the copilot vs. autopilot distinction, gross margin evolution from services (30–40%) to software (70–80%), and the difference between commoditized intelligence and defensible judgment. Market size expansion models and the ease of transitioning agency services into software-margin businesses remain speculative venture hypotheses requiring empirical validation.
